description:
Answer one question about one Cubi Estate listing from that listing's own data.

    Use this when the user asks something specific about a listing you have
    already shown them — its condition, features, running costs, availability,
    what is included. The answer comes only from that listing's facts and
    description. When the listing does not say — or answers only part of the
    question — the reply says so and gives the unanswered part worded for the
    agent; it never guesses. Read-only: nothing is sent to the listing agent
    or the agency, and no contact details are returned. The answer text is
    AI-generated.

    Privacy: the question is passed to the AI model provider Cubi uses as its
    processor to compose the answer, and Cubi does not store its text — the
    call log keeps the listing id, the question's length, its topic categories
    and whether the listing could answer. Notice:
    https://www.cubi.estate/privacy-policy

    Args:
        listing_id: The listing URL exactly as shown in a search result, or a
            source-prefixed id from a prior result (e.g. `remax:12345`).
            Do not invent one.
        question: The user's question about this home, one question per call.
            Leave out the user's name, phone number, email address and any
            other personal details — they are not needed to answer.
        lang: ISO 639-1 language code for the reply (en/pt/es/fr/de/nl/ru).
            Defaults to en.
